name: auto-ship
description: Commit, push, run checks, open an issue and pull request, and merge in one command.

commands.title: Auto Ship: Commit, Push, Review and Merge

autoShip.checks.description: npm scripts to run as the review. A script that is missing from package.json is skipped.

autoShip.autoMerge.description: Merge the pull request automatically when every check passes.

autoShip.syncAfterMerge.description: After merging, switch to the default branch and pull the merged changes.

autoShip.confirm.description: Show the list of files and ask before committing.

autoShip.repository.description: GitHub repository (owner/name) to use when the folder has no origin remote. It is created if it does not exist.

autoShip.private.description: Create the repository as private when it is created from autoShip.repository.

scripts.publish:npm: npm run compile && cd npm && npm publish --access=public
